For provider pre-beta, #895 must record whether any admitted cohort provider still depends on the bridge and prove buyer-serving smoke after admission or upgrade. The broader legacy fleet retirement proof remains pending outside this slice.

Append-only signed discovery, protected renewal, anonymous v1.8.55 bridge verification, and the physical autoupdate journey contract are mapped. The 2026-07-27 partial artifact records 8GB Llama readiness, Air5/Qwen fail-closed rollback, and the original Pearl/Air5 blockers. The supplemental Air5 convergence artifact records Pearl advertising v1.8.61, M3 hardware-trust approval/verifier success, signed v1.8.61 package/catalog verification, Air5 ready/routing-eligible v1.8.61 admission, and target_not_newer coordinator observation. The remaining blocker is governance packaging: a #896 signed journey-result contract and explicit conformance promotion, not the earlier Air5 operational blocker.

Manual signed-release recovery, append-only transport, protected renewal, anonymous v1.8.55 bridge verification, and the physical autoupdate journey contract are mapped. The 2026-07-27 partial artifact records 8GB Llama manual update no-op at v1.8.61 and Air5/Qwen fail-closed behavior for the v1.8.56 updater plus installer rollback when SSH Keychain access is unavailable. The supplemental Air5 convergence artifact records successful GUI manual recovery to v1.8.61 after coordinator hardware trust was unblocked. Disconnected or coordinator-rejected recovery still needs signed journey-result packaging before promotion.

Local signed-set health, exact-set success binding, startup recovery, rollback policy, and the physical autoupdate journey contract are mapped. The 2026-07-27 partial artifact records 8GB Llama local binary/discovery/update-lock state and Air5/Qwen rollback after required hardware-evidence admission returned HTTP 429 before service start. The supplemental Air5 convergence artifact records that the blocker was removed and that Air5 committed v1.8.61 bytes, exact CLI SHA-256, launchd activation, local model readiness, and Pearl ready admission. A controlled committed-target rollback fault and signed journey-result packaging remain open before promotion.

Mutation-lock ownership, launchd helper fencing, listener-bound commit gates, rollback-entry fencing, legacy first-hop bridge regressions, and the physical autoupdate journey contract are mapped. The 2026-07-27 partial artifact records Air5/Qwen launchd PID change across installer rollback, restored provider/watchdog/manifest/service state, and empty update locks after the run. The supplemental Air5 convergence artifact records successful launchd service activation at v1.8.61, Pearl ready/routing-eligible admission, encrypted leg and hash verification, model_loaded telemetry, and an HTTP 200 buyer request routed to Air5. Signed journey-result packaging still needs to bind lock/fence/listener/cleanup evidence into a promotable conformance record.

SPEC-023 advisory TPS/TTFT behavior is repaired in code and tests. The provider-prebeta admission journey is now mapped to prove the operator-visible autotune transcript and model-readiness decision on a real provider; real-X dwell reward evidence remains outside the provider-admission subset unless explicitly enabled.

A6 repairs human transcript label honesty, benchmark-count semantics, and donor-mode warning copy in code and tests. The provider-prebeta admission journey is now mapped as the scoped physical installer/autotune proof; conformance remains pending until #895 captures the operator-visible transcript in production-equivalent conditions.

B2 implements coordinator route/capacity exclusion for over-ceiling and uncatalogued heartbeat model transitions under strict hello-gate unit tests. The provider-prebeta admission journey is now mapped to capture the active cohort gate posture, admitted model ceiling, and route eligibility; strict-gate production rollout remains pending unless enabled for the cohort.

B2 adds the 30s session-time autotune evidence TTL route-exclusion sweep for capped strict hello-gate sessions. The provider-prebeta admission journey is now mapped to record evidence freshness and whether stale-evidence routing exclusion is active for the cohort; proactive refresh and broader production deploy evidence remain pending outside this slice.

B5 parks evidence-absent strict hello-gate providers in a non-buyer/admission-limited/no-credential sandbox, reloads proof_of_weights config without restart, pre-quarantines/revalidates existing sessions on gate enable, clears gate exclusions for credential-authorized sessions, leaves sandbox-only/no-credential sessions sandboxed on gate-disable reload, and clears disabled telemetry-drift benchmark quarantines on reload. The provider-prebeta admission journey is now mapped to record the cohort admission/sandbox posture; FR-HG5 below-two alert and broader Pearl deploy evidence remain pending outside this slice unless enabled.

The signed 42efce21 acceptance candidate proved that both authenticated provider hardware-profile UPSERT paths failed under the intended provider_onboarding column-limited grants. The SQL has been repaired without widening authority. The provider-prebeta admission journey is now mapped to prove replacement hardware-profile submission and verifier acceptance for the cohort.

The fragment contract, capability gate, and rollback rules are implemented and unit-tested. For provider pre-beta, referral/invite admission is scoped to provider admission and now maps to JOURNEY-PROVIDER-PREBETA-ADMISSION; conformance remains pending until #895 captures the current production posture for a fresh provider. Real-X dwell rewards and broad advocacy economics remain outside this slice unless explicitly enabled.
